start.title: Quiet Fields
start.text:
The flock sleeps under cold stars.
The night is long and still.

choices.feedback: Luke 2:8 — Shepherds were "keeping watch over their flock by night."

sleep_consequence.title: Stay Awake
sleep_consequence.text:
A faithful watch is a holy thing.
Keep your post.

wander_consequence.title: Return to the Flock
wander_consequence.text:
The sheep need your care tonight.
Go back to your post.

light.title: A Sudden Light
light.text:
The night cracks open with glory.
An angel stands before you.

choices.feedback: Luke 2:9 — The shepherds were "greatly terrified" by the angel's appearance.

run_consequence.title: Do Not Be Afraid
run_consequence.text:
The angel speaks gently to you.
Return and listen.

choices.feedback: Your fear gives way to peace.

attack_consequence.title: Lower Your Staff
attack_consequence.text:
This light brings news, not harm.
Receive it with reverence.

choices.feedback: Your staff falls to the grass.

message.title: Good News
message.text:
"Today in Bethlehem a Savior is born.
You will find him in a manger."

choices.feedback: Luke 2:15 — The shepherds said to one another, "Let us go over to Bethlehem and see this thing that has happened."

doubt_consequence.title: Trust the Sign
doubt_consequence.text:
A child in a manger awaits.
Go and see for yourself.

travel.title: Toward Bethlehem
travel.text:
The road is dark but your steps are sure.
The town glows ahead.

choices.feedback: Luke 2:16 — The shepherds "went with haste" to Bethlehem.

choices.text: Bring fine gifts to buy first

wait_consequence.title: Go Now
wait_consequence.text:
The Savior waits in a manger tonight.
Do not turn back.

gifts_consequence.title: Empty Hands Are Enough
gifts_consequence.text:
He receives the poor as the rich.
Go as you are.

worship.title: The Child
worship.text:
He lies in a manger, just as told.
His breath is soft, his face is light.

choices.feedback: Luke 2:16 — The shepherds found Mary and Joseph, and the baby lying in a manger.

silence_consequence.title: Come Closer
silence_consequence.text:
He is the One the angel spoke of.
Worship him with your whole heart.

return.title: Praising as You Go
return.text:
You return to the fields rejoicing.
Heaven has touched the earth tonight.
